These five files are verbatim copies of the hub's flx/flx-codec/src/*.js
(the @deadark/flx-codec package), vendored here because this project has no build step
and *.defxn.com's gateway shell (../app.js) needs to import decodeArchiveAsync as a
real browser ES module served same-origin, with no bundler/npm install to resolve a
package specifier through.

Vendored at flx-codec commit 8aa7ba2 ("flx-codec: .flx format dispatcher and optional
manifest purpose"), re-copied 2026-10-23. Browser-safe decode came in 3fb58e3.
Re-copied 2026-10-24 for flx-codec 0.1.1 (uncommitted at the time): the encoder caps its dictionary at the
decoder's 4096-entry limit and writes the rest as literals.
blake3.js is what the shell checks a site's bytes with (../../content.js): WebCrypto has no
BLAKE3. tests/gateway-flx-codec-vendor.test.mjs fails if any copy drifts from flx-codec.
Do not hand-edit these files; re-copy them from flx-codec/src/ instead, the same
"copy, cite, don't diverge" convention used elsewhere in this workspace (see
CMS-ARK/src/lib/mesh/overlay.ts's header comment). flx-codec is the canonical source;
this is a deployment artifact of it, not a fork.

Resync command, from the defxn repo root:
  cp ../../flx/flx-codec/src/{index,codec,binary,dictionary,blake3}.js gateway/vendor/flx-codec/
